body: You Have to Be Willing to Leave Everyone Else Behinc. If you want to be Free then you have to be willing to leave everyone else behind. You have to be willing to say goodbye forever. You have to be willing to give up the pretense that there was ever another. If you want to discover the One, you have to abandon the many. You cannot have both. 1 8 0 You Are in the Work No Matter Where You Are You Are in the World No Matter Where You Are Doing Is Being as Much as Not-Doing Is Being Truth Is Not an Object 1 8 1
